init_FixedHighLevelPolicy: initialize a FixedHighLevelPolicy that parses PDDL solution actions for each environment
parse_solution_actions: parse the PDDL problem solution into a list of action names and arguments
get_next_skill: get the next high-level skill and arguments from the fixed solution plan
apply_mask: apply a binary mask to reset the next skill index for selected environments
filter_envs: filter and clean up stateful variables to match only active environments
